newsitem.title: FINLAND: TT TIETO HITS NEW HIGH ON FOREIGN DEMAND.
newsitem.headline: TT TIETO HITS NEW HIGH ON FOREIGN DEMAND.

text.p: Shares in Finnish data services group TT Tieto Oy rose sharply to a new life-high on Wednesday on continued brisk foreign demand, brokers said.
At 1440/1140 GMT, TT Tieto traded at 262.00 markka, up 12.00 markka or almost five percent, after hitting a 265.00 life-high.
Trade was 5.1 million markka, which is lively for TT Tieto.
Some brokers said earlier demand for Tieto had had been boosted by a week-old buy recommendation from Merrill Lynch.
TT Tieto said earlier it had bought a small Swedish personnel administration systems group Habo Data AB but this had no connection with the gains, brokers said.
